notes: §1985:XII.2.4 GR3: without REPLACING "the library text is copied unchanged"; with it "each properly matched occurrence of pseudo-text-1, identifier-1, word-1, and literal-1 in the library text is replaced". ResolveOneCopy copies the library unchanged (witness 1985-GR-XII_2_4-9, p3a) and ApplyReplacements replaces every operand ParseReplacingOperands reads; at 85 OnNonPseudoTextOperand does not refuse the word, literal and identifier forms (witness 1985-GR-XII_2_4-3; p3d MOVE BY ADD, 1 BY 5, "OLD" BY "NEW" give oldNEW501; p3b T-E OF T-G (2), WS-S (2:3) and TBL (2) (1:1) as library text). But ReadOperand reads identifier-1/identifier-2 as a word, OF/IN qualifiers and ONE parenthesized group, so two identifier shapes §1985:IV.4.3.8.5.2 gives are refused: a subscripted and reference-modified identifier (Format 2: data-name, qualifiers, a subscript group, then a reference-modifier) and, from Amendment 1, a function-identifier (Format 1); §1985:IV.4.3.8.5.1 names "a syntactically correct combination of qualifiers, subscripts, or reference modifiers". Probes: a) p3c TBL (2) (1:1) refused; b) p3r: no operands, ==== and ==,== (SR3, SR9), COPY as word-1 or word-2 (SR6), a missing BY all refused, a repeated operand pair: first wins; c) p3e LEADING/TRAILING, p3f a literal text-name, p3g SUPPRESS refused COBOL0900; d) p3d numeric literal 01 not matched by 1, nonnumeric case kept; p3h FUNCTION UPPER-CASE ("ab") refused. kb/Work PB5469 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-read4/rd-06.json).

next.reason: No-REPLACING case unchanged: §2023:7.2.3.4 GR7 'the library text is included in the resultant text unchanged'. But 1985 replaces matched 'pseudo-text-1, identifier-1, word-1, and literal-1'; §2023:7.2.3.4 GR8 replaces only 'pseudo-text-1 or partial-word-1', and the rendered §2023:7.2.3.2 format (PDF p.76) offers only ==pseudo-text== and LEADING/TRAILING ==partial-word== operands. A 1985 COPY ... REPLACING identifier/word/literal is refused under 2023; partial-word replacement is added.
